changelog_v060_title: LocalSync P2P, Shared Guest Mode, Screen Lock & Encrypted Sessions
changelog_v060_item1: Startup loading screen with progressive loading bar and device profile selector.
changelog_v060_item2: Guest mode for shared school PCs with red badge, lesson lock screen and instant data wipe.
changelog_v060_item3: Workstation Screen Lock with customizable PIN and remote smartphone unlock (QR or push).
changelog_v060_item4: Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Session Backup & Restore on lock exit with 30-day auto-pruning.
changelog_v060_item5: Desktop multi-folder mirror sync (Google Drive, OneDrive, USB flash drive).
changelog_v060_item6: 256-bit cryptographic device pairing between PC and phone with zero-dependency SVG QR generator.
changelog_v060_item7: High-speed WebRTC peer-to-peer LocalSync with data chunking, compression and P2P signaling.
changelog_v060_item8: Bilateral differential Smart Merge with automated pre-sync safety snapshot.
changelog_v050_item1: New Tools module with DSA text simplifier (high readability fonts, contrast themes, and PDF print).
changelog_v050_item2: Quiz & Worksheet Builder (multiple choice, cloze, true/false, and parallel variants Row A / B).
changelog_v050_item3: Advanced School management with structured Municipality and Province fields.
changelog_v050_item4: Mobile UI polish, PWA installation fixes, and permanent element deletion fixes.
changelog_v040_item1: Import students from class rosters with automated electronic register name parsing.
changelog_v040_item2: Diary notes grouped hierarchically by School, Class, and Student.
changelog_v030_item1: Guided year rollover for promoting/retaining students into the new school year.
changelog_v030_item2: Comprehensive 360° overview modal cards for Schools, Classes, and Students.
changelog_v020_item1: Classroom observation dossier generator with formal ministerial print and export.
changelog_v020_item2: PEI pedagogical phrase customizer across the 4 ministerial dimensions.
changelog_v010_item1: PEI D.I. 182 compiler, quick diary, local 100% offline IndexedDB storage and PWA.
